Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent BLACK SILHOUETTE BOTTOM FOREGROUND STRIP A for a side-scrolling game.
Input image is a reference ONLY for the nearest black plants along its BOTTOM EDGE. Match those simple flowing organic silhouettes: dense low ground clutter, leaf tufts, thin and thick curved grass blades and long tapering fronds. Do NOT reproduce the room, characters, hanging plants, architecture or ceiling.
Create one VERY WIDE landscape 3:1 strip. Continuous dense solid black base attached flush across the full bottom edge. Silhouette foliage grows upward from this base. Most of the base stays low; only scattered, well spaced asymmetric clusters rise higher. Upper 40% of the canvas must remain completely transparent. Low foreground brush should not cover the playable middle of a screen. There must be at least two long quiet low stretches, no constant dense wall of tall grass.
Specific arrangement: Several loose clusters of elegant long bent grass blades and curved spear-shaped fern fronds, with small rounded leaf tufts between them. Tall group toward left quarter, another toward right third; quiet low gaps.
All visible artwork is PURE BLACK (#000000), flat silhouette without outlines, interior textures, gray shading, glow or colour. Preserve true transparent negative spaces between leaves/blades. Delicate clean antialiased edges and chunky readable groupings like the bottom foreground reference. Not rock terrain, lava, platforms or ledges. No detached floating parts. No text or grid.
At BOTH left and right image edges, keep a low BLACK BASE of the SAME HEIGHT with a nearly horizontal top profile, no tall leaves touching either vertical edge. This is important for seamless horizontal connections. Continue the base all the way to the image edges, no side margins and no vertical borders. Genuine transparent PNG background. This is a production layer asset, not a mockup scene.
